title: Tensor compatibility of a ringed square on flat K-flat representatives
statement:
Fix four ringed tensor corners and their canonical tensor models, edges f:Y→X, g:Y→Y′, h:X→X′, k:Y′→X′, and a ringed tensor square s as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation]. Write F,G,H,K for the four specified derived pullbacks, t_f,t_g,t_h,t_k for their canonical tensor comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and C_e(P) for the complex-to-derived comparison of edge e. Write q for the localization of complexes to the derived category. Suppose θ:G⋙K≅F⋙H satisfies, on every flat-term K-flat complex P of Y-modules,
θ_(q P);H(C_f(P));C_h(f*P)=K(C_g(P));C_k(g*P);q(s.modules_P),
where s.modules_P is the termwise module square. For any two flat-term K-flat complexes P,N of Y-modules, put V=q(P), W=q(N). Then
θ_(V⊗W);H(t_f(V,W));t_h(FV,FW)=K(t_g(V,W));t_k(GV,GW);(θ_V⊗θ_W).
Only these representative inputs are asserted; extension to arbitrary derived objects, projection maps, exchange maps, and adjunction mates are not part of this statement.

proof.text: Use the ordinary total-complex square for the specified module comparison, before localization. Its proof is the degreewise coproduct extension of ordinary module-sheaf tensor compatibility.

Pullback preserves flat-term K-flat representatives. The total tensor of two such representatives is again flat-term K-flat. The canonical complex-to-derived comparisons are isomorphisms on these representatives.

Extract the representative equation from the unique characterization of each canonical edge tensor comparison. For two composable edges, use naturality of the second tensor comparison, apply the two edge equations successively, and use naturality of its complex-to-derived comparison to combine the two ordinary total comparisons.

Precompose the desired equality with the inverse-image of the source representative identification, and postcompose with the target tensor of the two composite complex-to-derived comparisons. These are invertible by the preceding steps. Naturality of theta and its assumed representative equations at P,Q and their total tensor convert both composites to the ordinary total square localized by Q. Apply the ordinary total square and naturality of the final representative identification; cancel the invertible pre- and post-compositions.

proof_origin.place: F3: explicit two-edge representative equations and categorical conjugation of the ordinary module tensor square; Stacks 07A4 and 0D6D, tensor verification omitted in 0E48

theorem ringedSquareTensorCompatibility
    (s : RingedTensorSquare Y X Y' X' f g h k)
    (aY : RingedTensorModel Y) (aX : RingedTensorModel X)
    (aY' : RingedTensorModel Y') (aX' : RingedTensorModel X')
    (theta : g.left ⋙ k.left ≅ f.left ⋙ h.left)
    (htheta : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
        ((sheafCompose Y.topology (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj Y.ring)) ℤ),
      P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat → (∀ n : ℤ, (P.X n).IsFlat) →
      theta.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        h.left.map (derivedPullbackComplexComparison f.pullback f.left f.epsilon P) ≫
        derivedPullbackComplexComparison h.pullback h.left h.epsilon
          ((f.pullback.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
      k.left.map (derivedPullbackComplexComparison g.pullback g.left g.epsilon P) ≫
        derivedPullbackComplexComparison k.pullback k.left k.epsilon
          ((g.pullback.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex s.modules (.up ℤ)).hom.app P))
    (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose Y.topology (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj Y.ring)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hPf : ∀ n : ℤ, (P.X n).IsFlat)
    (hQ : Q.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hQf : ∀ n : ℤ, (Q.X n).IsFlat) :
    theta.hom.app (Y.tensor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
      h.left.map ((f.tensorComparison aY aX).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
      (h.tensorComparison aX aX').hom.app
        (f.left.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), f.left.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) =
    k.left.map ((g.tensorComparison aY aY').hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
      (k.tensorComparison aY' aX').hom.app
        (g.left.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P), g.left.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) ≫
      X'.tensor.map (CategoryTheory.Prod.mkHom
        (theta.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
        (theta.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)))
